I posted the ticket list in #strategic-pod as a reply to you. It has five Vantorre Group (parent) tickets, each with its source:

1. #8841: #strategic-pod, Jul 1, and Moss's 5/4 and 9/30 digests. The sources disagree on site and status (Allentown kiosk timeout vs. Newark carrier portal), so please confirm.
2. #PD-8841: Moss's 4/27 digest (Allentown missed carrier check-ins). It's unclear whether this is the same ticket as #8841.
3. #PD-4418: Moss's 9/15 digest (export dropping timestamps at Dock Door 9). The digest doesn't name Vantorre, so this one is an inference.
4. INC-4821: #inc-vtg-hartford, Aug 3 (Hartford status-page access issue).
5. VT-55120: #inc-vtg-hartford, Oct 14 (root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage).

I left out #4812 (Vantorre Mobility) and #PD-4402 (Quillfeather). The 8/3 digest covers the Hartford incident but gives no ticket number. I read only the channels you're in and Moss's public digests.
